description: Monthly average quoted UK household interest rate for a 2-year fixed-rate mortgage at 75% loan-to-value, series IUMBV34. Returns the most recent N months (default 24, max 120). Data: Bank of England Statistical Interactive Database (bankofengland.co.uk/boeapps/database), no auth required, UK Open Government Licence v3.0.

last_n.description: Number of most recent months to return, counting back from the current month (default 24, max 120 = 10 years). This is a monthly series.
